entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on IA no. 13284/2023, which is an application for stay.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that private complaint has been filed under section 7 and 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and the charge has been framed under the same Act by the trial Court, but the aforesaid Act has been abolished and new law namely Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 has been enacted.
In view of the aforesaid, till further order, further proceeding in RCT no. 489/2017 pending before the Court of JMFC, Mandsaur shall remain stayed.
I.A no. 13284/2023 stands disposed of accordingly.
